settingsui.parallelValue: {count, plural, one {one check at a time} other {# checks together, the heavy alone}}
settingsui.timeoutsNote: From the catalog; each check’s timeout is edited in «Project setup» ← «Checks».
settingsui.preventSleepNote: The computer stays awake until the run ends, and any sleep gap is recorded.
settingsui.notifyNote: A system notification when a run ends.
settingsui.locationText: AYAR’s data folder on this computer (Application Support)
settingsui.retentionNote: A run kept forever is never deleted.
settingsui.purgeNote: Deletes the runs, the evidence and the profiles kept in AYAR, and never touches your repositories.
settingsui.noTelemetry: No usage measurements: AYAR sends no data about how you use it or your projects.
settingsui.patternsNote: Added to AYAR’s built-in patterns, applied before anything is kept, shown or copied.
settingsui.patternInvalid: An invalid pattern; it was not saved.
settingsui.templateNote: Run on «Open in editor» for a finding or a log; it names '{file}' and may name '{line}'.
settingsui.templateInvalid: An invalid template: it must name '{file}'.
settingsui.costLead: AYAR is local and free: no account, no balance, no call to a paid service.
settingsui.costLocal: Every check runs on your computer: the build, types, tests, secrets, permissions, accessibility and the rest. No network, no service.
settingsui.costNetwork: Dependency vulnerabilities when their database updates, external links, and tool downloads: declared data to a declared destination, after your consent.
settingsui.costModel: Model checks (instruction files) and fix guidance: the cost is your subscription’s with your provider; AYAR does not know or estimate it.
settingsui.copies: Copied for the model in the last 30 days
settingsui.copiesNote: How many times «Copy for the model» was used in the current project, with no money estimate.
settingsui.narrowNote: The «narrow scope» mark shows on a karat computed from fewer criteria.
settingsui.logLimitNote: Beyond 2 MB per log is cut with a visible mark; its start and end are kept.
